mentions.name: Bold
mentions.description: Video intelligence platform for coaching programs and training companies. It performs deep transcript and metadata extraction over large video libraries, then layers RAG search and an AI assistant that answers questions with timestamped citations back to the exact video moment, so students can find the content they need and coaches field fewer repeated questions. Built on a Phoenix/Elixir backend with Next.js portals and a two-tier RAG architecture.
mentions.problem: Coaching and training businesses sit on 200-500+ hours of video content that becomes a "content graveyard" — students can't find what they need, coaches burn out answering the same questions, and churn stays high.
mentions.audience: Coaching programs and training companies, including their coaches and students
